entries.text: The DuckDB SSB and TPC-DS tuned templates now carry measured evidence states. At SF1 on DuckDB v1.5.5 with 16 GiB host memory the SSB template is measured-benefit against notuning (geometric mean ratio 0.6687, 95% interval 0.6457 to 0.6992) and the TPC-DS template is measured-regression (load time 13.6 times notuning). The DuckDB TPC-H template stays SF1-only: SF10 could not be measured on this host.
